notes: Hold-out set, labelled by hand from the catalogue itself (blocks.json names and summaries, plus a read of each candidate's summary) before any search or ranking code was looked at. No query was chosen, tuned or re-labelled by running site search or the evaluation script. Queries are new: none is copied or paraphrased from recommendation-eval.json. Mix: 40 vague outcome goals (area vague), 30 beginner phrasings, 20 typos or bad grammar, 30 outside marketing (finance and accounting, HR, teaching and study, software and data, legal paperwork, personal habits, design), 20 that name a tool (Shopify, QuickBooks, Excel, Notion, Google Ads, Slack, WordPress, GA4, Zapier, Stripe, Meta, Zendesk), 20 about AI itself. search.expect: any of these in the top 5 is a hit; the first listed is the best single answer; every listed item is one a careful person would be happy to land on. Tool-named queries whose tool is not named in the catalogue (for example QuickBooks) are labelled with the generic job item that does the work. goals.steps: each inner list is one needed step, satisfied by any slug in it. next.good: links a careful person would follow next; next.goodTasks: jobs where a next link is acceptable even if not listed. gaps: queries a visitor could plausibly type where the catalogue has no good item (checked by searching names and summaries for the topic); use them to test that weak matches are shown honestly, not to score hits. Use this file only to check that ranking changes generalise, not to tune against.

gaps.q: file my self assessment tax return
gaps.why: manage-tax holds only cash-tax and deferred-tax reconcilers and one tax planning brief; nothing helps prepare or file a return.

gaps.q: mortgage affordability calculator
gaps.why: No mortgage or home-loan item; personal-finance items cover budgets, debt payoff and retirement only.

gaps.q: set up payroll for my first employee
gaps.why: Payroll appears only as a line inside the cash forecast builder; no payroll setup item.

gaps.q: how to register an llc
gaps.why: No company formation item; only a company filing deadline tracker for companies that already exist.

gaps.q: help me write my will
gaps.why: No estate planning or personal legal documents.

gaps.q: visa application checklist for working abroad
gaps.why: Only a study-abroad advisor; no work visa or immigration item.

gaps.q: design an instagram post in canva
gaps.why: Canva is not covered; image items are AI image prompt and generator skills, not template design.

gaps.q: pinterest strategy for my shop
gaps.why: No Pinterest item; social planning covers other platforms.

gaps.q: open an etsy shop
gaps.why: Only an Etsy search results collector; no Etsy shop setup or listing item.

gaps.q: start a dropshipping business
gaps.why: No dropshipping item; supplier and store setup items assume you hold or make the product.

gaps.q: excel vba macro to automate my report
gaps.why: The only VBA mention is a MATLAB bridge; no Excel macro writer.

gaps.q: google sheets formulas and apps script
gaps.why: No Google Sheets or Apps Script item.

gaps.q: build a tableau dashboard
gaps.why: Dashboard items cover Power BI, Plotly and offline HTML; Tableau and Looker are not covered.

gaps.q: what business insurance do i need
gaps.why: No business insurance item; the only insurance items are claims reserves and a patient service writer.

gaps.q: plan a wedding
gaps.why: No wedding or private event planning item.

gaps.q: weekly meal plan and grocery list
gaps.why: Cooking minds teach technique and plan single meals; no meal planning or shopping list item.

gaps.q: workout plan for beginners
gaps.why: No fitness or exercise item.

gaps.q: tips to sleep better
gaps.why: No sleep or health advice item; habit planners exist but do not cover sleep.

gaps.q: guitar lessons for beginners
gaps.why: No music practice or instrument learning item; the audio items make music and voiceovers.

gaps.q: which ai tool should i use for my task
gaps.why: No AI tools directory or tool chooser yet; items cover setting up and using one assistant.

gaps.q: chatgpt vs claude vs gemini
gaps.why: No comparison of AI assistants; the catalogue is about using them, not ranking them.

gaps.q: invoice template for my small business
gaps.why: Invoice items check and chase invoices; none generate an invoice or template.

gaps.q: make a gantt chart for my project
gaps.why: No Gantt or schedule chart item; project items cover plans, status and risks.

gaps.q: design a flyer for my shop
gaps.why: Poster items exist but no flyer, brochure or print layout item.

gaps.q: design a business card
gaps.why: No business card or stationery item.

gaps.q: set up asana for my team
gaps.why: No Asana, Trello, Monday or ClickUp item; only Jira, Linear and Notion project helpers.

gaps.q: choose a web host for my site
gaps.why: Deploy items cover Vercel, Netlify, Render and Cloudflare for developers; no web host chooser for non-developers.

gaps.q: set up xero for my small business
gaps.why: No Xero, FreshBooks or accounting software setup item; accounting items are generic.

gaps.q: meditation routine for stress
gaps.why: No meditation or stress management item; wellbeing items are for staff programmes and lessons.
